## INPUTS

- trend_20 per-day parameter: see D8_BAR_DEFS.md section 2 (s_rng of this td)
- FIRST ROW OF THE INPUTS TABLE is the PRECEDING bar of the series (last bar of the previous session in the engine order sess_id, known time); it only supplies the edge state (the engine takes the edge over the whole bar series of ALL sessions).
- Rule: minute used = the last COMPLETED CL 1-minute bar at the bar known time (minute start + 60 s <= floor(known time to whole seconds)); r15 = close/close[15 min earlier] - 1 (NaN if either missing or the contract id changed inside the window); sigma = std (ddof 1) of r15 over the 4,320 grid minutes before that minute (>= 600 valid values, current minute excluded); z = r15/sigma; NaN counts as 0. UP = z >= +2.0, DN = z <= -2.0, each an EDGE over the series; AGAINST: LONG on the DN edge, SHORT on the UP edge. Signals are taken only from London bars (sess code 1) with part = 0; order time = floor(known second) + 2 s; the engine drops an event at or after the session end (08:30 ET).
- Below: INPUTS (per bar) then the raw CL 1-minute closes covering the 15 minutes before the first used minute through the last used minute (Databento ohlcv-1m CL continuous calendar-front series; instrument_id changes at the roll).
